title: Venting or Emotional Commentary (Editorial Exhaustion)
pattern: Comments containing subjective, emotional, frustrated, or finger-pointing prose instead of technical explanations.
why_bad: Fails to explain the technical invariants, limitations, or workarounds required to maintain the code, replacing logic with emotional noise.
detection: Comments containing frustrated language, developer names, or colloquialisms ('garbage', 'hack', 'trash', 'dumb').
counterexample: Pragmatic, dry warnings documenting external API defects, accompanied by ticket numbers or issue URLs.
fix: Rewrite the comment to state the technical constraints and invariants objectively, or fix the code.
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 4 ("Comments - Noise Comments"), pp. 64-66.
